_about: The token tree build_tokens.py turns into tokens.json. drinkdouze.com's Shopify theme declares its colour roles as RGB triplets in an inline :root block (resolved to hex by vars.mjs) and douze-custom.css declares the brand layer (--color-dusk/sable/flavor-*, --font-*, the --text-* ramp) as ordinary vars. Declared variables become var leaves; painted values the sheets never declare are measured leaves from raw/components-computed.json.
